headline: Symbolic barrier broken. Minister announces new fuel prices
summary: From Wednesday, the maximum price of Pb95 petrol will be no more than 5.99 zloty per litre, Pb98 6.64 zloty and diesel 7.57 zloty. The energy minister announced the caps on Tuesday.
why: Regulated maximum fuel prices affect Polish consumer inflation and the margins of domestic fuel retailers.
original_headline: Symboliczna granica przełamana. Minister podał nowe ceny paliw
